target.statement: IDSIM of 0.7733 for the proposed IDE method on the LR-contour identity-guided face generation task

compute.basis: No code is released, so the full dual-encoder + StyleGAN inversion pipeline must be reimplemented and trained on 30k 1024x1024 CelebA-HQ images, which is a multi-day GPU training job far beyond a few CPU hours.

blockers: No code or pretrained weights released
Requires training a StyleGAN-inversion dual-encoder on 30k 1024x1024 images
Needs a pretrained StyleGAN generator and ArcFace model
Evaluation requires generating 28,420 test outputs to compute IDSIM/FID
Training is GPU-bound; not feasible on an 8-core CPU laptop
title: Identity-guided Face Generation with Multi-modal Contour Conditions
